entries.subject: scenario

rules: Judge only the clause text.
A named file, field, value, argument, exit status, message, stop, or presence/absence of something is observable.
Words like better, faster, robust, natural, thorough, wisely, without a stated measure or bound, are not observable.

criteria.observable: It states a concrete outcome a test or a retained artifact can check (a value, file, field, argument, status, message, stop, or the absence of one).
criteria.unobservable: It states a quality, feeling, intention or improvement with no concrete measure that a test could check.
criteria.not_behaviour: It is a scoping note, a reference to another Intent, or a statement about the contract itself rather than behaviour.

offline: it is about Kogen's own outputs (arguments, files, records, sizes, hashes, controller decisions) that an offline test with fakes can check, even when a real run would also show it.

criteria.provider_only: Only a real provider run can show it.
criteria.offline: An offline test with fakes can check it.

criteria.none: The scenario requires no listed non-goal.

rules: Judge only from `cited_lines`; do not use outside knowledge of the repository.
supported: the lines directly show the claim is true. contradicted: the lines show something incompatible with the claim. insufficient: the lines are about something else or do not settle it.

criteria.contradicted: The cited lines show something incompatible with the claim.
criteria.insufficient: The cited lines are about something else or do not settle the claim.
